items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/OPTIMISM then officially ACTIVE for Week 7 vs Raiders despite calf issue.
items.why: Weekend injury summary and Schefter confirmation of active designation.
items.implication: Full or near-full role expected; reverse any prior fade.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY then confirmed ACTIVE for MNF; post-game said hamstring came out great and back issue unlikely to sideline him.
items.why: ETR summary plus Schefter active report and player comments via McManus.
items.implication: Clear for normal workload ROS barring setback; gutsy efficient outing.

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM path leading to INACTIVE for Week 7.
items.why: ETR weekend summary aligned with prior Rapoport unlikely reports.
items.implication: Missed time opens short-term committee or backup opportunity.

items.text: Jonah Coleman first game back led Broncos backfield: 50% snaps, 41% rush share, 34% routes; Dobbins 21% snaps, Harvey fluky TD. LOVE/upgrade; roster in 100% leagues.
items.implication: Must-add waiver; primary Broncos RB going forward.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: worst runner (last in YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet RB13 PPR ppg via 9 inside-5 carries and NFL-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Volume and scoring opportunities override efficiency.
items.implication: Sustainable floor via targets/goal-line despite poor running.
items.conflict: Efficiency metrics terrible vs backup in same scheme

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle turned on purposeful slide; Levitan says almost certainly fine, would have been tilting if truly injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Purposeful slide; no lasting concern expressed.
items.implication: No significant missed time expected; maintain RB1 ranking.
Huntley starting; Flowers/Henry usage under backup.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT for MNF vs Cowboys.
items.why: ETR OUT list confirmed in inactives.
items.implication: Elevated opportunity for remaining PHI pass-catchers and slot options vs DAL.

items.text: Josh Jacobs listed IN and returned for Packers.
items.implication: Resumes lead role; ROS value discussion ongoing.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Excited for Doyle/Lamar healthy return impact.
items.why: Efficiency elite under backup; full Lamar boosts ceiling.
items.implication: Major upside spike when Lamar returns.

items.text: Ravens G Vega Ioane (top rookie) MCL sprain; short-term, will miss a little time.
items.implication: OL hit for Ravens; potential run/pass protection impact short-term.

items.text: Can we PLEASE put some respect on Tee Higgins’ name?
Tony Pollard exploded Sunday; sell-high opportunity if possible.
Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24, Noel 15 (turf toe early exit), Hutchinson 15, Boutte 13, Marvin Harrison 8, Tank Dell 6 (return limited).
items.implication: Nico clear WR1; Dell limited role initially.
